data.name: Pendulum Double

colours.name: Play Orange
alts: Pendulum Double two-user outdoor pendulum swing exerciser with orange footplates

data.description: The Pendulum Double gives two people a swinging step each. Users stand on the orange footplate, hold the handlebar and swing both legs together from side to side like a pendulum. The movement loosens the hips, waist and lower back and gives a light workout for the core. It is easy to learn, so walkers in a park or residents in a society can use it without instruction. With two stations on one frame, it handles a busy morning crowd. It comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Pendulum Double, our standard cover would be 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, confirmed in your quote.

items.pText: The Pendulum Double gives two people a swinging step each. Users stand on the orange footplate, hold the handlebar and swing both legs together from side to side like a pendulum. The movement loosens the hips, waist and lower back and gives a light workout for the core. It is easy to learn, so walkers in a park or residents in a society can use it without instruction. With two stations on one frame, it handles a busy morning crowd. It comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Pendulum Double, our standard cover would be 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, confirmed in your quote.

Each footplate hangs from a bearing at the top of its arm, and these bearings need regular greasing. We install the Pendulum Double self-standing or grouted. Leave space on both sides of each station, because the step swings outward, and keep walkers from cutting between the two users.
